reason: This is a broad, central API change to expression evaluation (`expression.Eval`) that propagates through core expression, executor, planner, table, and coprocessor/mock-store paths. Even if much of the diff is plumbing, changing how evaluation context is passed can hide high-severity correctness regressions in SQL semantics, session/statement-context handling, constant folding, plan cache behavior, aggregate evaluation, point-get/subquery execution, and pushed-down/cop execution. The change set is large and concentrated in high-blast-radius modules, so it merits a dedicated deep review.
